_comment: Adventurers Guild for CHIM: the Oghma topic and aliases each knowledge-pack entry is filed under (CHIM brings an entry in when the talk names its topic or an alias). Entries the pack gives only to some factions are not listed: CHIM gets those through the speaker's factions instead (chim.json). src/chim/build_dwpkg.py fails on a pack entry that is neither here nor faction-bound.
_guidelines: Sent with a line only when the talk is about the Guild or someone present holds a guild rank: the few rules of SkyrimNet's guidelines/0511_guild_guidelines.prompt every NPC needs, kept short.
guidelines: The Adventurers Guild is an Emperor-chartered guild of freelance adventurers; in Skyrim the innkeeper of each hold capital's inn keeps its counter. Bring it up only when the talk is already about it, or about work, monsters, ranks or adventuring; a character's own rank or party is part of who they are, not something to announce. Say "the Adventurers Guild" or speak of adventurers, never just "the Guild" (that could mean the Thieves Guild). Only adventurers hold a guild rank, from E (novice) to S (legendary), said as "a C-rank adventurer"; an adventurer met on the road is never above A. Let rank colour how adventurers treat each other: deference to much higher ranks, rivalry among peers. Never state the rank of a beast or foe: only the Guild's Appraisal reads those.
